svg.title: Step 7 mockup 14: Follow along: standings, a live session, champions, the rules (attendees, spectators)
svg.text: 14 · Follow along: standings, a live session, champions, the rules (attendees, spectators)
Use case: anyone at the event follows the tournament from the hub without playing: what's on, who leads, who won

g.text: After 5 of 6 sessions · top 10 to the final
The top 10 play the final on Sunday.
Written by the organiser; the points
come from the settings, so the page
Results stay with the event; names

svg.text: Standings and the live view are public inside the event: no sign-in for reading (U15).
The live session is the bracket widget's data on a phone; it updates by push (D10).
A champions page per event: the final's top three with photos, then each session's winner (U16).
The rules page is written by the organiser; the points come from the settings, never typed twice.
After the event: the player's own summary; results seed the next event in the same series (D13).
Retention: results anonymised after 12 months, counts and totals stay (tenants contract).
